observed_failure.result: A checkpoint event write failed on a valid staged v2 logical-name manifest left unpublished by an earlier interrupted write. The existing Store raised INTEGRITY_FAILURE before publishing a generation.

behavior.unfenced_event_append: After SequenceTaken, retry at the next increasing sequence so an unpublished immutable identity cannot trap retries on the same sequence.
behavior.generation_fenced_append: Clears the local hint and raises EventGenerationConflict as before.
behavior.checkpoint_result: Pending one authenticated retry after Environment delivery. No claim is made that a checkpoint has succeeded yet.

invariants: No Store bytes or bindings were deleted or rewritten.
Event sequence order remains increasing; append-only gaps are tolerated.

store_recovery.behavior: New immutable manifests are addressed by representation root. A changed retry gets a distinct manifest path; the older logical-name manifest remains immutable and unreferenced.
